description: resolveRoute scenarios on the plan's example registry (oMLX default, Gemma on LM Studio for vision, MiniMax for structure, Claude for notes). settings is raw (run it through parseAiSettings); expected is a subset of the result.

scenarios.name: altText routes the vision task to Gemma on LM Studio
frontmatter routes the structure task to MiniMax on oMLX
notes go to Claude with Allow cloud on and consent granted
notes to Claude ask for consent first
cloud blocked: notes fall back to the default local route
cloud blocked with fallback none disables the surface
consent refused falls back to the default local route
fallback chain: oMLX down, anyLocal picks LM Studio
fallback default: vision engine off, the default route has vision
fallback never moves a local route to a cloud default without any
fallback any reaches the cloud after every local engine fails
fallback anyLocal stops before the cloud
fallback any still needs Allow cloud
capability gating: vision routed to a model without vision
disabled model is skipped by the fallback scan
no default and no task route
